notes.title: Demo Update 0.6
notes.notes: [p]After a couple of months of work the update for the Demo is ready.[/p][p]The original Demo lacked in a lot of aspects but it was successful at starting to bring in feedback.[/p][p]This update addressees that feedback and expands on the game's features.[/p][p]The card fight in the original version lacked and couldn't really be called a card fight. The complete system and UI of it has been reworked and now should create some more interesting experiences i hope.[/p][p]There's been a lot of polishes in the way the ship controller works, making it easier to control the fleet, with some visual improvements to it.[/p][p]A few new ships have been added to slowly start assembling a "bit of everything". At the moment the game contains a small variability is ships from missile carriers to huge fuel carrying tankers to small agile fighter ships. To provide a challenge to the player and to also give them options on the battle field.[/p][p]Along with a lot more small changes that hopefully elevates the experience.[/p]

notes.title: Playtest from version 0.6 released
notes.notes: [p]The past couple for months after releasing the original demo for Metal Coffin I've managed to gather a lot of feedback and got to see a lot of the shortcomings of the game.[/p][p]The 0.6 update aims to fix a lot of those and give the game some identity.[/p][p]To anyone who gets to try it I'd love to hear your thoughts.[/p][p]Full release of the demo build is expected in upcoming weeks.[/p]
